edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute described as [IDENTIFY DISPUTE, INCLUDING CASE CAPTION AND NUMBER IF APPLICABLE] (the “Dispute”).

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising from the Dispute, whether known or unknown, existing as of the date this Agreement is executed by both parties. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or impair either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by applicable law, regulation, or legal process; disclosures to its legal, tax, accounting, or other professional advisers who are subject to professional confidentiality duties or agree to keep the information confidential; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Any disclosure under an exception shall be limited to information reasonably necessary for that purpose.
